svg.text: Off-road hunting pickup · Caleb Roe — contestant vehicle dossier
“Gray light. Something moved in the brush. I’d been hunting forty years. I didn’t miss.”
Tarp over a shape on the hood — the wrong size
Antlers wired to the grille; front winch
A single rifle in the rack — never fired since
Danny’s blaze-orange cap on the mirror
A mud-caked 1980s off-road pickup truck with a
front winch, antlers wired to the grille, a tarp-
covered shape strapped to the hood, a single
rifle in the rear rack, rugged and rural,
Realistic · Symmetry On · Quad · ~55k tris · PBR 4K
